shared_elements: standing human figures in profile walking in file
hoofed animal in profile led by a human
hand of a figure resting on/touching the animal's back or head
horizontal band of rosettes bordering the scene
figures with patterned headgear/hair and long garments
figure holding a small object/vessel or staff
justification: Both show the identical scheme of a file of profile human figures in patterned headdress advancing in one register, each reaching forward to lead a hoofed animal shown in strict profile, all set above a border band of rosettes on a groundline — a very specific and conventional tribute-procession formula. The chief difference in content is the animal led (a large two-humped camel with an accompanying tree in A, versus a pair of horned rams with fleece rendered as overlapping scales in B) and the correspondingly different scale relation between figure and beast.
